english.note: Use 徵收 specifically when an authority collects a tax, fee, or other levy.
Use this for an authority imposing and collecting taxes, fees, or other compulsory payments.

examples.english: The government will impose a waste disposal fee starting next month.
examples.traditional: 政府下個月開始徵收垃圾處理費。
examples.jyutping: zing3 fu2 haa5 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 zing1 sau1 laap6 saap3 cyu2 lei5 fai3

examples.english: The government will exact this fee.
